title: YNX AI — Permission-bound assistance for the YNX ecosystem
metaDescription: Draft, explain, research, translate and preview with explicit context selection, provider transparency and no autonomous asset or account actions.
h1: Useful assistance, bounded by your permissions
features: Provider-neutral streaming and truthful unavailable, quota and timeout states
Product AI Registry with deny-by-default context and tool policies
Preview and approval records that never execute external actions
Conversation export, deletion and retention controls
Web, Android and iOS product surfaces
risksAndLimits: The current release is a local Testnet preview, not a public Runtime.
No provider-backed staging success or live generation is claimed.
Product-context records remain unavailable until each owner adapter is accepted.
AI output may be inaccurate and is advisory; it cannot sign, pay, trade, publish, delete or change permissions.
Hosted downloads, production signing and store release are not verified.
